name: Tactile push button 12x12 mm
source: Typical 12x12x7.3 mm 4-leg tactile switch datasheet (legs on a 12.5 x 5.0 mm grid); not yet measured
notes: Legs 12.5 mm apart (across the body) are always connected; the two legs on the same side, 5 mm apart, are the switch. Pins a and b are that normally-open pair. If the button has a snap-on colored cap, the cap adds height and needs a bigger lid hole; measure it.
